description: Analyze free-preview ETF overlap and region/sector/single-company concentration findings, known ongoing charges and regional/sector exposures from published evidence. Identify each holding with exactly one ISIN or ticker; a ticker can be ambiguous across exchanges. Use positive relative weights, values in one base currency, or omit all amounts for equal weights. Never mix weights and values. At most 10 distinct tickers per call. A single-company finding's isin is an ISIN when one is published, otherwise the fund file's own identifier. Dates, coverage and all data gaps accompany the result. Returns checkUrl: a shareable link to the same result.

isin.description: ISIN with a valid check digit.

ticker.description: Exchange ticker, e.g. VWCE or SWDA.L; may match listings on several exchanges.
